name: GitLab
description: Access projects, issues, merge requests, and CI/CD workflows through GitLab's official MCP server or API.
notes: Supports GitLab.com through either the official MCP server (beta) with OAuth or the API with a personal access token. For the OAuth MCP connection to work on GitLab.com, MCP server access must be enabled for a top-level group you belong to (set GitLab Duo availability to Always on or On by default for the top-level group, turn on beta and experimental features, and allow access to the MCP server); otherwise GitLab rejects the connection with a 404 after OAuth, which the client reports as 'Session terminated'. For GitLab Self-Managed, edit the MCP URL to your instance's server and the OAuth flow discovers the host-specific endpoints.

auth.credentialHelp: Create a token in [GitLab access token settings](https://gitlab.com/-/user_settings/personal_access_tokens) with the api scope.

installHint: The GitLab MCP server supports OAuth 2.0. Before installing, make sure an admin has enabled 'MCP client access' for the top-level GitLab group you belong to. If this prerequisite isn't met, GitLab returns 404 after OAuth and the connection fails with 'Session terminated'. For GitLab Self-Managed, edit the URL to https://<your-instance>/api/v4/mcp and make sure MCP server access is enabled for the instance.
